title.narrative: Bridges of Trust – Improving social cohesion and resilience in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed Project is to improve social cohesion in Bosnia and Herzegovina through an evidence-based understanding of divisive narratives and opportunities to build trust. This will lead to data-driven interventions aimed at shaping an enabling environment for the country’s democratic development and European integration. In consultation with stakeholders and representatives of the Danish MFA and Danish Embassy in Sarajevo, three broad priority areas of intervention have been identified:1.Robust research framework and publicly accessible datasets on social cohesion, resilience, and inclusive participation are established and used to inform policy decisions and development programming in Bosnia and Herzegovina.2.Targeted oversampling and analysis at the local level, in communities prone to heightened social tensions, to generate in-depth local insights that inform tailored policy responses and address context-specific challenges to social cohesion and gender inclusion.3.Enhanced local mechanisms and multi-stakeholder platforms in place across Bosnia and Herzegovina to foster intergroup trust, counter divisive narratives, and support inclusive participation of underrepresented groups, particularly women and youth in public decision-making.
